kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننحسم (form VII)
# نَنْحَسِمُ (nanḥasimu) /nan.ħa.si.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# نَنْحَسِمَ (nanḥasima) /nan.ħa.si.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# نَنْحَسِمْ (nanḥasim) /nan.ħa.sim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
